VERDICT: ACCEPT
I completed independent pass-1 review of candidate df60d140135beb31867087435c1015343529a089, confirmed HEAD matched, read the full base-to-candidate diff and touched files/tests, and made no edits.
Per-criterion verdicts: AC-3 satisfied — src/math.mjs:69–73 validates and calculates max minus min, with required examples at test/math.test.mjs:85–89; R-1 satisfied — src/math.mjs:69–71 enforces Array.isArray, nonempty input and finite numeric elements with the required exception classes; R-2 satisfied — src/math.mjs:72 sorts a copy and test/math.test.mjs:96–99 checks nonmutation; R-3 satisfied — automated comparison confirms src/math.mjs:1–66 and existing test lines remain unchanged except the permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3; R-4 satisfied — no dependencies or generated files changed, package.json:1–10 unchanged, and the diff contains only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs; R-5 satisfied — all added tests at test/math.test.mjs:85,88,91,96 use the range prefix; findings: none.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/ exited 0 with "tests 4", "pass 4", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 19", "pass 18", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing at test/math.test.mjs:14 (15 !== 10), the documented unchanged baseline defect; supplemental read-only Node assertions printed "Supplemental range assertions: PASS (18 invalid inputs, empty array, 7 frozen valid arrays)" and "Preservation and changed-path assertions: PASS"; the initial supplemental heredoc could not run because the sandbox prohibited a shell temporary file, then the same assertions ran successfully through node -e without file creation; remaining uncertainty: shipped validation tests do not individually cover every invalid class, but supplemental assertions verified them, no required check remains unavailable, and acceptance remains the coordinator's decision.
